svg.title: How a website stays accessible and quick
svg.desc: You write the pages in docs/. MkDocs builds the website with the hook and the stylesheet of the blueprint, which underline the links in the text, give the theme the contrast of WCAG 2.2 AA, load each picture as the reader comes to it and only in its theme, play a GIF with an MP4 beside it as that video, and pin the release of Mermaid. After the build, the check docs opens every page in Chrome, in the light and the dark theme, and runs axe-core on it; each serious or critical violation shows in the summary and as an annotation at its page. Without one, the website is published.
